entities.name: Registration area
entities.description: A set of tracking areas assigned to the UE by the AMF during registration procedure, managed independently per access type (3GPP or non-3GPP).

entities.name: Tracking area
entities.description: A geographical area consisting of one or more cells, identified by a TAI constructed from TAC and PLMN identity.

entities.name: Tracking Area Identity
entities.description: Identifier for a tracking area, constructed from TAC and PLMN identity, broadcast in cells.

entities.name: TAI list
entities.description: List of tracking areas assigned to the UE by the AMF to reduce tracking area update signaling.

entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function that assigns registration areas and TAI lists to the UE.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that receives and uses the TAI list for mobility management.

entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which the AMF assigns a registration area and TAI list to the UE.

entities.name: Mobility registration update
entities.description: Registration update with 5GS registration type IE set to 'mobility registration updating' in REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: Last visited registered TAI
entities.description: The last visited TAI stored in non-volatile memory in USIM or ME, included by UE to AMF.

relations.description: AMF assigns registration area to UE during registration procedure.
Registration area is defined as a set of tracking areas.
Tracking area is identified by a TAI.
AMF assigns TAI list to UE to reduce tracking area update signaling.
UE does not trigger registration procedure for mobility as long as it stays in TAI list areas.
UE includes last visited registered TAI to AMF, stored in non-volatile memory.
